{{Quote|Take it, Ordo. It gives me great pleasure to know that Ma Vau no longer has it, and that a better woman does.|Walon Vau, giving Ordo Skirata his mother's sapphires|<ref name="tc">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
'''Walon Vau's mother''' was one of Walon's family members who disowned him after he joined the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] was considered to be a religious fanatic. She had a bauble of [[shoroni sapphire]]s that Walon stole from the [[Dressian Kiolsh Merchant Bank]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]].<ref name="tc" />
